name: io.github.Servosity/saas-alerts-mcp
title: SaaS Alerts MCP
description: SaaS Alerts alerts, Respond rule triggers and response across every customer tenant.

environmentVariables.name: SAAS_ALERTS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SaaS Alerts partner API key (Settings in the SaaS Alerts console).

environmentVariables.name: SAAS_ALERTS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends.

environmentVariables.name: SAAS_ALERTS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 so the MCP server only reads and previews.

environmentVariables.name: SAAS_ALERTS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by stdio.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector (no tenant-gated profiles); leave unset. It does not limit access.
